name: slider
title: Slider
description: An animated slider for React and shadcn, single or range, with a live value readout.

meta.details: A Base UI slider, single or range. The thumb swells while held, and the readout's digits roll when the value steps, then follow the finger exactly while dragging.

docs: Import Slider from components/eased/slider/slider. Props: value or defaultValue (a number, or two for a range), onValueChange, onValueCommitted, min, max, step, largeStep, format, locale, label, showValue, disabled. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
